business_problem: ZenCreator needed a production AI platform that could sustain more than one million image and video generations per month, reduce false positives in commercial creative, and keep cost per generation viable as usage scaled across creators and agencies.
solution_summary: ZenCreator runs its image and video generation business on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, making the Wan and Qwen model families the primary engines behind a high-volume creative application. All production traffic is routed through the Model Studio international endpoint in Singapore and integrated with the DashScope API and Python SDK. The platform uses Wan for video and image generation, Qwen for image generation and editing, and LoRA fine-tunes on Wan 2.7 to preserve consistent character identity across outputs. Requests are submitted asynchronously and then polled through the task API, allowing ZenCreator to absorb peaks in demand without blocking end-user workflows. This design is tuned for commercial creative use cases—social, advertising, e-commerce, lip sync, virtual try-on, and editing—where the company must balance visual quality with predictable operating costs. By combining Alibaba Cloud model APIs with its own orchestration layer, ZenCreator turned managed multimodal inference into a scalable production pipeline for more than 1.5 million creators and agencies.
business_outcome: ZenCreator scaled to over one million monthly generations and more than 1.5 million registered users while keeping cost and quality aligned for commercial creative work.
